headline: Dead Lands And Coastal Sectors Erupt As Island Fronts Recede
war_summary: Fighting has flared sharply in Dead Lands and Palantine Berm over the past two hours, while earlier flurries in Tempest Island and Marban Hollow have largely subsided. Dead Lands has emerged as the most violent sector on the map, logging four base exchanges alongside more than four thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour window, heavily contesting positions at Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point. Palantine Berm recorded four recent shifts of its own, driven by skirmishes around Leiri Hermanni and Vendett. Endless Shore remains locked in stubborn combat, adding three fresh base transitions to reach thirty-seven events on the day near Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel. Fresh tactical changes have also stirred Stlican Shelf around The South Wind and Thornhold, with coastal skirmishing registering in The Fingers and Stema Landing. Meanwhile, severe casualty tolls continue to mount across Weathered Expanse and Farranac Coast even as their fortified lines hold firm.
